reason: The HTTP MCP entrypoint unconditionally registers 11 callable GA4 tools using Analytics Admin v1beta and Analytics Data v1beta APIs.

tools.name: list_ga4_properties
tools.description: List GA4 accounts and properties available to the authenticated Google account.
tools.behavior: Lists accounts with Analytics Admin v1beta accounts.list, then lists properties filtered by each account parent. Returns account display/resource names and property display/resource names, extracted property IDs, timezone and currency.
notes: Neither accounts.list nor properties.list paginates, so results may omit later pages.

tools.name: get_ga4_traffic_summary
tools.description: Get GA4 traffic summary for a property and date range.
tools.behavior: Runs a single date-range report with sessions, totalUsers, newUsers, screenPageViews, engagedSessions and conversions; returns the raw API response data as JSON text.

tools.name: get_ga4_top_landing_pages
tools.description: Get top landing pages from GA4.
tools.behavior: Runs a report grouped by landingPagePlusQueryString with sessions, totalUsers, engagedSessions and conversions, passing the numeric limit as a string. Returns raw report data.
notes: limit is an unconstrained number, not restricted to positive integers; the handler stringifies it for the GA API.
No orderBys is supplied, so the handler does not explicitly sort the returned rows.

tools.name: get_ga4_traffic_by_channel
tools.description: Get traffic grouped by GA4 default channel group, source and medium.
tools.behavior: Runs a report grouped by sessionDefaultChannelGroup, sessionSource and sessionMedium with sessions, totalUsers and conversions. Passes limit as a string and returns raw report data.
notes: limit is an unconstrained number, not restricted to positive integers; the handler stringifies it for the GA API.
No orderBys is supplied, so the handler does not explicitly sort the returned rows.

tools.name: compare_ga4_date_ranges
tools.description: Compare GA4 traffic between two date ranges.
tools.behavior: Runs one report with named current and previous date ranges and sessions, totalUsers, newUsers, screenPageViews, engagedSessions and conversions. Returns raw report data without calculating comparison deltas.

tools.name: analyse_organic_performance
tools.description: Analyse organic traffic quality, engagement and conversions for a GA4 property.
tools.behavior: Runs a report grouped by landingPagePlusQueryString and deviceCategory, filtered to exact sessionDefaultChannelGroup Organic Search, with sessions, totalUsers, engagedSessions, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration, screenPageViews and conversions. Orders sessions descending and returns raw report data.
notes: limit is an unconstrained number, not restricted to positive integers; the handler stringifies it for the GA API.

tools.name: analyse_landing_page
tools.description: Diagnose behaviour and conversion performance for one landing page.
tools.behavior: Runs a report grouped by landingPagePlusQueryString, sessionDefaultChannelGroup and deviceCategory, filtered by landingPagePlusQueryString CONTAINS pagePath. Requests sessions, totalUsers, engagedSessions, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration, screenPageViews, conversions and eventCount with fixed limit 50. Returns raw report data.

tools.name: analyse_conversion_drop
tools.description: Compare conversion performance between two date ranges and show where the drop may be coming from.
tools.behavior: Runs a report for named current and previous date ranges grouped by landingPagePlusQueryString and deviceCategory, filtered to an exact channel. Requests sessions, engagedSessions, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration and conversions, ordered by sessions descending with fixed limit 50. Returns raw data without computing or attributing a conversion drop.

tools.name: analyse_devices
tools.description: Compare GA4 performance by device category.
tools.behavior: Runs a deviceCategory report with sessions, totalUsers, engagedSessions, engagementRate, averageSessionDuration and conversions. Adds an exact sessionDefaultChannelGroup filter only when channel is truthy. Returns raw report data.

tools.name: analyse_events_by_page
tools.description: Show key events and user actions by page.
tools.behavior: Runs a pagePath and eventName report with eventCount, totalUsers and conversions, ordered by eventCount descending. Adds a pagePath CONTAINS filter only when pagePath is truthy, passes limit as a string and returns raw report data.
notes: limit is an unconstrained number, not restricted to positive integers; the handler stringifies it for the GA API.

tools.name: analyse_site_search
tools.description: Analyse internal site search behaviour if GA4 search_term events are tracked.
tools.behavior: Runs a report grouped by searchTerm with eventCount and totalUsers, ordered by eventCount descending, passing limit as a string. Returns raw report data.
notes: limit is an unconstrained number, not restricted to positive integers; the handler stringifies it for the GA API.
Source review only; no tools/list or live requests. HEAD matches the supplied revision.

All 11 tools are unconditionally registered by createServer for each MCP HTTP request. No optional modules or permission tiers exist. The root and OAuth Express routes are HTTP endpoints, not MCP tools.

Schemas are reconstructed from the explicit Zod raw shapes supplied to server.tool, including optional/default parameters and descriptions; additionalProperties false reflects the SDK object-schema conversion of default Zod object shapes. No nested schemas or references occur.

Authentication uses GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI and optional GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN. The provided OAuth endpoint requests analytics.readonly scope. Credentials and authorized GA access are required for API calls.
Date and property parameters are unconstrained strings. Every report handler prefixes propertyId with properties/ and returns raw API response data via JSON text.
Several reports request conversions; API metric availability and dimension/metric compatibility were not validated with live requests.
The OAuth routes are registered inside createServer, so each MCP request adds another set of Express route handlers.
Dependencies are declared as latest, though package-lock.json pins installed versions. The start script requires dist/index.js produced by npm run build; dist is not committed.

review.method: Root reviewed all 11 Zod registrations, required fields/defaults and GA4 runReport/list dispatch against src/index.ts; no realtime API or statistical drop calculation inferred.
